contrasts.access_scope: Publisher-indexed search excerpts; direct publisher access returned 403. Full independent re-audit pending.
contrasts.finding: Synthesis describes nonuniform temporal loss and different changes in strength and size; challenges using one universal slope or size-to-strength conversion.
contrasts.independence: Included-study overlap not mapped; not an independent participant cohort.

contrasts.access_scope: Original article abstract in PubMed, methods/results; publisher full text inaccessible in this pass.
contrasts.finding: Compares 13 male spaceflight participants with 11 male bed-rest participants using tibial-site pQCT muscle CSA; supports checking transferability but does not validate quadriceps MRI coefficients.
contrasts.independence: Different paper and protocol; no individual overlap audit completed.
